findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/L2/Covariance.lean:112` `theorem contractable_covariance_structure (hX : Contractable μ X) (hX_L2 : ∀ n, MemLp (X n) 2 μ)`, with `variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}` at line 43 — no finiteness instance. Lines 56–59 of the new file are exactly `map_values` then `contractable_covariance_structure`.
findings.fix: State `Contractable.covariance_structure_map_values (hX : Contractable μ X) (hX_meas) (hf : Measurable f) (hL2 : ∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => f (X i ω)) 2 μ) : …` (no `IsFiniteMeasure` needed, since `contractable_covariance_structure` has none) and derive the bounded version from it by supplying `hL2` via `memLp_comp_process_of_bound`.
findings.issue: Boundedness is used only to produce `∀ i, MemLp (f ∘ X i) 2 μ`; the general result — `Contractable μ X` + `Measurable f` + `∀ i, MemLp (fun ω => f (X i ω)) 2 μ` ⟹ uniform means/variances/off-diagonal covariances — is never stated. A user with an unbounded L² observable (the ordinary case of the L² lane) must redo the `map_values` + `contractable_covariance_structure` composition by hand.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/Indicator.lean:67` shows the Mathlib convention `(C : ℝ) (hfC : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖ ≤ C)`; line 42 of the new file discards the slack with `ae_of_all μ fun ω => hf_bound (X i ω)`.
findings.fix: Weaken to `∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖f (X i ω)‖ ≤ C` (resp. `∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |f (X i ω)| ≤ C`), passing it straight through instead of wrapping with `ae_of_all`.
findings.issue: `hf_bound : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C` demands a bound on all of `α`, stronger than what the proof needs: only the values attained a.e. by the coordinates matter. Same defect at line 50 (`∀ x, |f x| ≤ C`).

findings.evidence: Lines 39–42: the body is `intro i; exact MemLp.of_bound (hf.comp_aemeasurable (hX i)).aestronglyMeasurable C …` — the index `i` is used only to project out `X i` and `hX i`.
findings.fix: State it for one map: `theorem memLp_comp_of_bound {g : Ω → α} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖f (g ω)‖ ≤ C) (p : ENNReal) : MemLp (fun ω => f (g ω)) p μ`, and get the process form at the use site as `fun i => memLp_comp_of_bound hf (hX i) C … p`.
findings.issue: `memLp_comp_process_of_bound` has no process content — the proof is `intro i` followed by a single-coordinate argument, and nothing relates the coordinates. Packaging it as `X : ℕ → Ω → α` with a `∀ i` conclusion means it cannot be applied to a single random variable or to a `Fin n`/`ι`-indexed family.

summary: The bounded case is proved directly instead of deriving it from the natural L²-observable statement, and both new theorems carry a global boundedness hypothesis stronger than the a.e. bound their Mathlib backend takes. The first lemma is also needlessly specialized to ℕ-indexed families.
